flags.message: Decisive forward signal predating the snapshot: Wolford v. Lopez (No. 24-1046, decided 2026-06-25) resolved the companion private-property question and is the hook for the petition's alternative GVR request. Used as legitimate pre-snapshot context; nothing about this petition's own disposition was retrieved.

The snapshot's second distribution entry follows a pre-consideration 'Rescheduled' entry, so distribution_count=2 overstates true relists (the petition has not yet been considered at conference). The companion petition No. 25-1206 (CourtListener docket 73281690) could not be read from the cell to confirm it shares the 10/9 conference.
